address.title: Token contract address
address.description: Address of the Robinhood Assets Jersey (RHJ) stock token. Must expose uiMultiplier().

decimals.title: Decimals
decimals.description: Token decimals. Every RHJ token is 18. This only controls how the share count is formatted; the multiplier is always divided by 1e18.

morpho.title: Morpho Blue singleton
morpho.description: Optional. When set with markets, collateral posted in those markets counts toward the holder voting weight. Omit for the original balance-only behaviour.

markets.title: Morpho market ids
markets.description: Market ids whose collateralToken is this stock token. Frozen into the proposal so a ballot states exactly which markets it counted.
